subject: Help with API rate limit after priority change
text: Our service provider portal is rejecting authentication requests after I switched the project to the faster support tier, and I need help before the client demo at noon. I understand the change in priorities may have left the sandbox configuration incomplete, but the error still says access token expired every few minutes even after clearing cookies and using a new key. Could you check whether the billing account has the same permission group, or if another technician needs to approve the upgrade manually? I can share screen recordings, but I cannot access the diagnostic logs until the login works.
